description: This PHP source file defines the class 'XTemplate', which provides a template engine for generating HTML content using file-based templates with support for blocks, variables, and nested parsing. It includes methods for loading templates, assigning variables, parsing blocks, and rendering output. The file also contains licensing comments and versioning history.

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a templating engine for HTML generation, supporting nested blocks, variable substitutions, and template file processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the template with a file, optional include directory, and main block name.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns a variable or an array of variables to the template.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a value to an array variable within the template variables.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a specified block, substituting variables and processing nested blocks.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether a specified block exists or has been parsed.

methods.name: var_exists
methods.description: Checks whether a variable exists within a specific block.

methods.name: rparse
methods.description: Recursively processes a block and all its sub-blocks.

methods.name: insert_loop
methods.description: Inserts a loop by assigning a variable and parsing a block.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the parsed output of a block as a string.

methods.name: out
methods.description: Outputs the parsed block, considering access control if applicable.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the parsed content of a block.

methods.name: parsed
methods.description: Checks whether a block has been parsed.

methods.name: SetNullString
methods.description: Defines a fallback string for unassigned variables.

methods.name: SetNullBlock
methods.description: Defines a fallback string for unparsed blocks.

methods.name: set_autoreset
methods.description: Enables automatic resetting of sub-blocks after parsing.

methods.name: clear_autoreset
methods.description: Disables automatic resetting of sub-blocks.

methods.name: scan_globals
methods.description: Includes global variables into the template's variables collection.

methods.name: maketree
methods.description: Generates a hierarchical array of blocks from template content, recognizing nested blocks.

methods.name: get_error
methods.description: Returns the current error message, if any.

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Sets an error message.

methods.name: getfile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file.

methods.name: r_getfile
methods.description: Recursively loads a file and replaces {FILE "filename"} directives with file contents.
